widgets.title: Database Availability Uptime %
widgets.description: Availability (available) is a point-in-time signal: "can I reach this database right now?" It's a binary 0 or 1 captured each collection cycle.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE available = 1) AS 'Uptime %' FROM MysqlHealthSample WHERE checkType = 'implicit' AND label.instance IN ({{instance}}) TIMESERIES FACET label.instance

widgets.title: Health Check Error Rate
widgets.description: Error rate across all check types (implicit, explicit, query). A non-zero rate indicates connectivity, auth, or query issues.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE hasError = 1) AS 'Error Rate %' FROM MysqlHealthSample WHERE label.instance IN ({{instance}})

widgets.title: DB Fleet Status
widgets.description: How many instances are reporting and their current availability state.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT uniqueCount(label.instance) as 'total instances', filter(uniqueCount(label.instance), WHERE available = 1) AS 'up', filter(uniqueCount(label.instance), WHERE available = 0) AS 'down' FROM MysqlHealthSample WHERE checkType = 'implicit' AND label.instance IN ({{instance}}) SINCE 10 minutes ago

rawConfiguration.text:
## Database Availability & Uptime
---

#### Availability
A **point-in-time** signal captured each collection cycle: *can I reach this database right now?*

All checks emit `MysqlHealthSample` with a `checkType` attribute:

| checkType | Method | What it proves |
|---|---|---|
| **implicit** | MySQL protocol ping (COM_PING) | Server is listening and responds at the wire level |
| **explicit** | Canary SQL query (e.g. `SELECT 1`) | Query parser, execution engine, and auth layer are functional |
| **query** | Internal monitoring queries | Individual query health and duration |

> Implicit is lightweight but won't catch thread exhaustion or read-only violations. Explicit exercises the full query path.

---

#### Uptime %
Availability **aggregated over a time window** — what fraction of checks succeeded?

Uptime % = (successful checks / total checks) × 100

At a **10s interval** over 5 minutes ≈ 30 checks. If 1 fails → **96.7% uptime**.

---

#### MysqlHealthSample Schema

All `MysqlHealthSample` events share:
- `hasError` (0/1) — single field to find all errors
- `errorCode` — classified error type
- `errorMessage` — sanitized error detail
- `durationMs` — execution time

#### Connection Timing (implicit/explicit only)

| Metric | Definition |
|---|---|
| **`durationMs`** | Total round-trip time: DNS + TCP + TLS + MySQL auth + query response |
| **`dnsLookupMs`** | Time to resolve the hostname to an IP via DNS |
| **`tcpConnectMs`** | Time for the TCP three-way handshake to the resolved IP |

> A spike in DNS or TCP time indicates infrastructure issues, not MySQL. A spike in durationMs with normal TCP suggests MySQL-level contention.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE available = 1) AS 'Uptime %' FROM MysqlHealthSample WHERE checkType IN ('implicit', 'explicit') AND label.instance IN ({{instance}}) TIMESERIES FACET label.instance, label.availability_zone

widgets.title: Response Time (DNS + TCP + Query)
widgets.description: Connection phase breakdown: DNS resolution, TCP handshake, and total query duration across implicit and explicit checks.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT max(durationMs), max(dnsLookupMs), max(tcpConnectMs) FROM MysqlHealthSample WHERE checkType IN ('implicit', 'explicit') AND label.instance IN ({{instance}}) TIMESERIES FACET label.instance

widgets.title: Errors Over Time
widgets.description: Error count by classified error code across all check types.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM MysqlHealthSample WHERE hasError = 1 AND label.instance IN ({{instance}}) FACET errorCode, label.instance TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT count(*) FROM MysqlHealthSample WHERE hasError = 1 AND label.instance IN ({{instance}}) FACET errorCode

widgets.title: Recent Errors
widgets.description: Most recent error per unique error code/message combination.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(errorMessage), latest(durationMs), latest(label.instance), latest(checkType) FROM MysqlHealthSample WHERE hasError = 1 AND label.instance IN ({{instance}}) FACET errorCode

widgets.title: Health Check Configuration
widgets.description: Active check types and canary queries per monitored instance.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT uniqueCount(checkType), latest(query), latest(label.role), latest(label.service_name), latest(label.availability_zone), latest(label.environment) FROM MysqlHealthSample WHERE label.instance IN ({{instance}}) FACET label.instance SINCE 30 minutes ago

widgets.title: Availability by AZ
widgets.description: Uptime grouped by availability zone — surfaces zone-specific outages.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE available = 1) AS 'Uptime %' FROM MysqlHealthSample WHERE checkType = 'implicit' AND label.instance IN ({{instance}}) FACET label.availability_zone

widgets.title: Availability by Service
widgets.description: Uptime grouped by service_name — useful for comparing health across deploys.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE available = 1) AS 'Uptime %' FROM MysqlHealthSample WHERE checkType = 'implicit' AND label.instance IN ({{instance}}) FACET label.service_name

widgets.title: Slowest Internal Queries
widgets.description: Top internal monitoring queries by average duration. High values may indicate MySQL server pressure.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(durationMs) FROM MysqlHealthSample WHERE checkType = 'query' AND label.instance IN ({{instance}}) FACET queryName LIMIT 15

widgets.title: Query Duration Over Time
widgets.description: Internal monitoring query performance trends. Spikes correlate with MySQL load.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(durationMs), percentile(durationMs, 95) FROM MysqlHealthSample WHERE checkType = 'query' AND label.instance IN ({{instance}}) FACET label.instance TIMESERIES AUTO
